title: Why sales is more than just selling
caption: Selling early pays you back before the revenue does: insight, a process and trust.

second-reason.title: Second reason
second-reason.keywords: cash is the first reason, pays back before revenue, insight, process, trust
second-reason.script: Cash is the first reason to start early. There is a second one, and it pays you back before a single dollar of revenue shows up. Selling early is not only about the money it brings in. It gives you three things: insight, a process, and trust.
